response.sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS entries FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, entries, entries - AVG(entries) OVER () AS entries_diff_from_avg FROM agg ORDER BY nationality

assumptions.assumption: An 'entry' is one row in constructorResults, so each nationality's entry count is the number of constructorResults rows for its constructors. SUM ignores NULL points.
The average is the unweighted mean of the per-nationality entry counts. Only nationalities that have at least one constructorResults row are included, which is what an inner join gives.
